meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses ast-grep to search and rewrite code by syntax shape rather than plain text. It can find every function, call, import, etc. matching a pattern, and apply deterministic codemods with preview.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for structural code search or batch rewriting, e.g., 'find all functions taking a Request parameter' or 'rewrite console.log to logger.info'.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Searches by AST structure and lists matches.

say_en.text: Rewrite all console.log to logger.info across the project.
say_en.note: Shows a preview first, then applies.
Generates a rewrite you can verify.
